payload.title: Newsroom shows what editors' votes did
payload.description: Per publication, show votes sent, votes recorded by Cyclotron, the last retraining round, held-out agreement before and after, and which version is live. If Cyclotron asks for a human to promote a candidate, show it as a review request using the standard Accept/Reject vocabulary. Read from the router's FB# receipts and Cyclotron's round status. Gherkin specs required. Lucide icons only, no borders, and never colour alone.
